<instructions>
Build a timezone overlap checker web app using a popular web framework of your choice. Do NOT use vanilla JS or a raw Node.js `http` server. The app must run with a single command (`npm run dev` or equivalent).

You have **full creative freedom** on everything: technology choices, code architecture, file structure, component separation, state management, styling approach, design system, and UX. Own every decision — make it clean, well-structured, and something you're proud of.
</instructions>

<purpose>
A tool for remote workers, distributed teams, and digital nomads who need to find common meeting windows or compare their schedule against colleagues in other timezones.
</purpose>

<modes>
The app has two modes the user can toggle between:

**Meeting Mode** (default)
Find hours when everyone across all selected cities is simultaneously awake. All cities share the same highlighted overlap window. Think: scheduling a group call where every participant must be available.

**Base Mode**
One city is the "base" (the reference). Each other city gets its own independent overlap calculated only against the base. Different cities may highlight different hours. Think: a person living in one city who works with people in several other cities and wants to see per-person availability.
</modes>

<cities>
- Users maintain a list of cities to compare. Default: San Francisco, Denpasar, Geneva.
- Cities come from a predefined catalog of ~34 cities spanning all major world regions (North America, South America, Europe, Africa, Middle East, Asia, Oceania).
- Users add cities via a searchable dropdown (search by city name or country). Remove any city from the list. No duplicates allowed.
- No custom/arbitrary timezone entries — only the predefined catalog.
</cities>

<reference-city>
- The first city in the list is always the **reference city**, visually marked (e.g. a "REF" badge).
- All hour calculations are anchored to the reference city's timezone.
- Users can click any city's name to promote it as the new reference (it moves to the top).
- In Base Mode, overlap is computed between the reference city and each other city independently.
</reference-city>

<availability>
Users configure their personal "awake window" via a settings panel:

- **Wake-up hour** (0–23, default: 7)
- **Sleep hour** (0–23, default: 23)
- **Time format**: 12h or 24h (default: 12h)

The awake window applies uniformly to all cities (everyone shares the same sleep schedule). Overnight ranges are supported (e.g. wake at 22, sleep at 6 for night-shift workers). Changes take effect immediately.
</availability>

<grid>
The core visualization is a **24-column grid** (one column per hour of the reference city's day, 0–23).

Each cell shows what hour it is **locally** in that city when it's that column's hour in the reference city.

Three visual states per cell:
1. **Sleeping** — the local hour falls outside the awake window → faded/muted
2. **Awake, no overlap** — awake but not part of the overlap → neutral
3. **Overlap** — awake AND this hour qualifies as overlap → highlighted (e.g. green), bold text
</grid>

<overlap-summary>
Displayed above the grid when 2+ cities are present:

- **Meeting Mode**: total overlap hours count + time range(s) in the reference city's timezone. Zero overlap → warning message.
- **Base Mode**: one line per non-reference city, each with its own overlap count + time range(s). Zero overlap → individual warning.

Time ranges are inclusive start → exclusive end (e.g. "9am — 12pm" = hours 9, 10, 11). Non-contiguous windows are shown as separate badges/ranges.
</overlap-summary>

<timezone-math>
- UTC offsets derived from the current date → DST is automatically handled.
- Fractional offsets supported (e.g. India UTC+5:30, Nepal UTC+5:45).
- Each city displays its current UTC offset.
</timezone-math>

<responsive>
**Desktop (≥768px)**: cities as rows, hours as columns (horizontal grid). Left: city info + REF badge + UTC offset. Center: 24 hour cells. Right: remove button.

**Mobile (<768px)**: cities as columns, hours as rows (vertical layout). These are **two separate layouts**, not a single responsive grid.
</responsive>

<persistence>
All state (city list, settings, active mode) is persisted to localStorage. Refreshing restores the last configuration. A new browser/incognito session starts with defaults.
</persistence>

<defaults>
On first visit:
- 3 cities: San Francisco, Denpasar, Geneva
- Meeting mode active
- Awake window: 7am–11pm
- 12-hour format
- Overlap summary showing common availability across the 3 default cities
- A hint at the bottom: "Green cells = everyone awake"
</defaults>

<important>
- `<title>` and page heading must be your model name (e.g. "Claude Sonnet 4.5" or "GPT-4o")
- The grid must make overlaps **instantly obvious** — alignment is critical
- Full creative freedom on colors, typography, and visual style — design the best possible UI/UX
- Polished, production-quality — not a prototype
</important>

Work only inside the current working directory. Do not read, list, search, or edit files outside the current working directory. Treat it as a standalone project root.
During setup, configure your app and package scripts to use port 9364, then use that port for runtime verification.
Use pnpm exclusively if dependency installation or package scripts are needed. Do not use npm.
Set the browser title and the primary visible title to your model name, using only identity information already available to you. Add nothing else to either title.
Run the relevant checks yourself. Do not edit files outside the current working directory.

+      year: 'numeric',

+ * Derived from the wall-clock time the Intl database reports, so DST and
+ * fractional offsets (India +5:30, Nepal +5:45) are handled for free.

+export function getUtcOffsetMinutes(timeZone: string, at: Date): number {
+  const parts = getFormatter(timeZone).formatToParts(at)

+    read('hour'),
+    read('minute'),
+    read('second'),
+  )

+  offsetMinutes: number

+  summary: OverlapSummary | null

+  const end = sleep * 60

+    : localMinutes >= start || localMinutes < end

+import { chromium } from 'playwright-core'
+
+const browser = await chromium.launch({ channel: 'chrome' })
+
+async function open(width, height = 900, scheme = 'light') {
+  const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width, height }, colorScheme: scheme })
+  const page = await context.newPage()
+  await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:9364/')
+  await page.waitForSelector('h1')
+  return { page, context }
+}
+
+const sym = { sleep: '.', awake: 'o', overlap: 'G' }
+
+for (const width of [1440, 1024, 768]) {
+  const { page, context } = await open(width)
+  const data = await page.evaluate(() => {
+    const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=city-row]')].map((row) => ({
+      city: row.dataset.city,
+      ref: row.dataset.reference,
+      states: [...row.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=hour-cell]')].map((c) => c.dataset.state),
+      labels: [...row.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=hour-cell]')].map((c) => c.textContent),
+      lefts: [...row.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=hour-cell]')].map((c) => Math.round(c.getBoundingClientRect().left * 10) / 10),
+      widths: [...row.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=hour-cell]')].map((c) => Math.round(c.getBoundingClientRect().width * 10) / 10),
+      offset: row.querySelector('[data-testid=utc-offset]')?.textContent,
+    }))
+    const headers = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=hour-header]')].map((h) => {
+      const r = h.getBoundingClientRect()
+      const head = h.querySelector('.hour-head')
+      return { left: Math.round(r.left * 10) / 10, now: head.dataset.now, bg: getComputedStyle(head).backgroundColor }
+    })
+    return {
+      rows,
+      headers,
+      docOverflow: document.documentElement.scrollWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth,
+      title: document.title,
+      h1: document.querySelector('h1').textContent,
+    }
+  })
+  console.log(`--- width ${width}`, 'title:', data.title, '| h1:', data.h1, '| overflowX:', data.docOverflow)
+  for (const r of data.rows) {
+    console.log(r.city.padEnd(14), r.ref, r.offset.padEnd(8), r.states.map((s) => sym[s]).join(''), 'cellW', r.widths[0])
+  }
+  console.log('labels SF   ', data.rows[0].labels.join(' '))
+  console.log('labels Denp ', data.rows[1].labels.join(' '))
+  console.log('labels Gen  ', data.rows[2].labels.join(' '))
+  const misaligned = data.rows.some((r) => r.lefts.some((l, i) => Math.abs(l - data.headers[i].left) > 0.6))
+  console.log('columns aligned with header:', !misaligned)
+  console.log('now header idx:', data.headers.findIndex((h) => h.now === 'true'))
+  await context.close()
+}
+
+await browser.close()

+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import { currentHourAtOffset, getUtcOffsetMinutes } from './timezone'
+
+const at = (iso: string) => new Date(iso)
+
+describe('getUtcOffsetMinutes', () => {
+  it('follows daylight saving time', () => {
+    expect(getUtcOffsetMinutes('America/Los_Angeles', at('2026-07-01T12:00:00Z'))).toBe(-420)
+    expect(getUtcOffsetMinutes('America/Los_Angeles', at('2026-01-15T12:00:00Z'))).toBe(-480)
+    expect(getUtcOffsetMinutes('Europe/Zurich', at('2026-07-01T12:00:00Z'))).toBe(120)
+    expect(getUtcOffsetMinutes('Europe/Zurich', at('2026-01-15T12:00:00Z'))).toBe(60)
+  })
+
+  it('handles southern hemisphere DST', () => {
+    expect(getUtcOffsetMinutes('Australia/Sydney', at('2026-01-15T12:00:00Z'))).toBe(660)
+    expect(getUtcOffsetMinutes('Australia/Sydney', at('2026-07-01T12:00:00Z'))).toBe(600)
+  })
+
+  it('supports fractional offsets', () => {
+    expect(getUtcOffsetMinutes('Asia/Kolkata', at('2026-09-30T00:00:00Z'))).toBe(330)
+    expect(getUtcOffsetMinutes('Asia/Kathmandu', at('2026-09-30T00:00:00Z'))).toBe(345)
+  })
+
+  it('has no DST for zones that do not observe it', () => {
+    expect(getUtcOffsetMinutes('Asia/Makassar', at('2026-01-15T00:00:00Z'))).toBe(480)
+    expect(getUtcOffsetMinutes('Asia/Makassar', at('2026-07-15T00:00:00Z'))).toBe(480)
+  })
+
+  it('switches exactly at the transition instant', () => {
+    expect(getUtcOffsetMinutes('America/New_York', at('2026-03-08T06:59:59Z'))).toBe(-300)
+    expect(getUtcOffsetMinutes('America/New_York', at('2026-03-08T07:00:00Z'))).toBe(-240)
+  })

+/** Minimal `matchMedia` stand-in: only `(min-width: Npx)` queries are understood. */
+let viewportWidth = 1280
+
+const listeners = new Set<() => void>()
+
+function matches(query: string): boolean {
+  const min = /\(min-width:\s*(\d+)px\)/.exec(query)
+  return min ? viewportWidth >= Number(min[1]) : false
+}
+
+Object.defineProperty(window, 'matchMedia', {
+  writable: true,
+  value: (query: string) => ({
+    get matches() {
+      return matches(query)
+    },
+    media: query,
+    addEventListener: (_: string, listener: () => void) => listeners.add(listener),
+    removeEventListener: (_: string, listener: () => void) => listeners.delete(listener),
+  }),
+})
+
+export function setViewportWidth(width: number) {
+  viewportWidth = width
+  listeners.forEach((listener) => listener())
+}
+
+export function resetViewport() {
+  viewportWidth = 1280

+import { chromium } from 'playwright-core'

+const browser = await chromium.launch({ channel: 'chrome' })

+let failures = 0
+const check = (label, ok, extra = '') => {
+  if (!ok) failures++
+  console.log(ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', label, extra)
+}
+
+async function fresh(width, height = 900, scheme = 'light') {
+  const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width, height }, colorScheme: scheme })
+  const page = await context.newPage()
+  const errors = []
+  page.on('console', (m) => m.type() === 'error' && errors.push(m.text()))
+  page.on('pageerror', (e) => errors.push(String(e)))
+  await page.goto(URL)
+  await page.waitForSelector('h1')
+  return { page, context, errors }
+}
+
+const names = (page) => page.$$eval('[data-testid=city-name]', (els) => els.map((e) => e.textContent))
+
+// ---------- Desktop flows ----------
+{
+  const { page, context, errors } = await fresh(1440)

+  check('h1', (await page.textContent('h1')) === 'Claude Sonnet 5.5')
+  check('default cities', JSON.stringify(await names(page)) === JSON.stringify(['San Francisco', 'Denpasar', 'Geneva']))
+  check('hint', await page.getByText('Green cells = everyone awake').isVisible())
+
+  // add city via search by country
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /add city/i }).click()
+  await page.getByRole('combobox').fill('india')
+  check('search by country shows Mumbai', (await page.getByRole('option').count()) === 1)
+  await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
+  check('Mumbai added', (await names(page)).at(-1) === 'Mumbai')
+  const mumbaiOffset = await page.locator('[data-city=mumbai] [data-testid=utc-offset]').textContent()
+  check('Mumbai offset fractional', mumbaiOffset === 'UTC+5:30', mumbaiOffset)
+
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /add city/i }).click()
+  await page.getByRole('combobox').fill('nepal')
+  await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
+  const kOffset = await page.locator('[data-city=kathmandu] [data-testid=utc-offset]').textContent()
+  check('Kathmandu offset', kOffset === 'UTC+5:45', kOffset)
+
+  // labels inside cells must not overflow their cell
+  const overflow = await page.evaluate(() => {
+    const bad = []
+    document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=hour-cell]').forEach((cell) => {
+      const cw = cell.getBoundingClientRect().width
+      cell.querySelectorAll('span').forEach((s) => {
+        if (s.getBoundingClientRect().width > cw + 0.5) bad.push([cell.dataset.city, s.textContent, s.getBoundingClientRect().width, cw])
+      })
+    })

+  check('no label overflow @1440', overflow.length === 0, JSON.stringify(overflow.slice(0, 3)))
+
+  // duplicates
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /add city/i }).click()
+  await page.getByRole('combobox').fill('mumbai')
+  const dis = await page.getByRole('option').getAttribute('aria-disabled')
+  await page.getByRole('option').click({ force: true })

+  await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
+
+  // promote

+  check('promote moves to top', (await names(page))[0] === 'Geneva')
+  check('single REF, on Geneva', (await page.locator('[data-testid=ref-badge]').count()) === 1 && (await page.locator('[data-city=geneva] [data-testid=ref-badge]').count()) === 1)
+  check('grid header follows ref', await page.getByText('Hours in Geneva').isVisible())
+
+  // reload persistence
+  await page.reload()
+  await page.waitForSelector('h1')
+  check('persisted order after reload', (await names(page))[0] === 'Geneva' && (await names(page)).length === 5, JSON.stringify(await names(page)))
+
+  // remove
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Remove Kathmandu' }).click()
+  check('removed', !(await names(page)).includes('Kathmandu'))
+
+  // settings
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /settings/i }).click()
+  await page.getByLabel('Wake-up hour').selectOption('9')
+  await page.getByLabel('Sleep hour').selectOption('2')
+  const sleepCount = await page.locator('[data-city=geneva] [data-state=sleep]').count()
+  check('overnight window applied (sleep 2..9 = 7 hrs)', sleepCount === 7, String(sleepCount))
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '24h' }).click()
+  const firstLabel = await page.locator('[data-city=geneva] [data-testid=hour-cell]').first().textContent()
+  check('24h format labels', firstLabel === '00', firstLabel)
+
+  // base mode
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Base', exact: true }).click()
+  const lines = await page.locator('[data-testid=overlap-line]').count()
+  check('base mode: one line per non-ref city', lines === 3, String(lines))
+
+  // persist mode+settings
+  await page.reload()
+  await page.waitForSelector('h1')
+  check('mode persisted', (await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Base', exact: true }).getAttribute('aria-pressed')) === 'true')
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /settings/i }).click()
+  check('settings persisted', (await page.getByLabel('Wake-up hour').inputValue()) === '9' && (await page.getByLabel('Sleep hour').inputValue()) === '2')
+  check('no console errors (desktop)', errors.length === 0, errors.join(' | '))
+  await page.screenshot({ path: 'scratch/flow-desktop-final.png', fullPage: true })

+  const { page, context } = await fresh(1440)

+      })

+      bad,

+    }

+  await context.close()
+}
+

+    cols: document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=city-column]').length,
+    hourRows: document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=hour-row]').length,

+  check(`${width}: no page-level horizontal overflow`, info.docOverflow === 0, String(info.docOverflow))
+

+    const before = header.getBoundingClientRect().top - table.getBoundingClientRect().top
+    table.scrollTop = 300
+    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50))
+    const after = header.getBoundingClientRect().top - table.getBoundingClientRect().top
+    return { before, after, scrollable: table.scrollHeight > table.clientHeight }
+  })
+  check(`${width}: sticky header`, Math.abs(pinned.before - pinned.after) < 1 && pinned.scrollable, JSON.stringify(pinned))
+
+  if (width === 390) {
+    // interactions on mobile
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /add city/i }).click()
+    const box = await page.getByRole('combobox').boundingBox()
+    check('390: picker inside viewport', box.x >= 0 && box.x + box.width <= 390, JSON.stringify(box))
+    await page.getByRole('combobox').fill('mumbai')

+    check('390: add city on mobile', (await page.locator('[data-testid=city-column]').count()) === 4)
+    const overflowCols = await page.evaluate(() => {
+      const t = document.querySelector('[role=table]')

+    await page.locator('[data-city=denpasar][data-testid=city-column] [data-testid=city-name]').click()
+    const first = await page.locator('[data-testid=city-column] [data-testid=city-name]').first().textContent()
+    check('390: promote on mobile', first === 'Denpasar', first)

+}
+
+// ---------- Dark mode contrast sanity ----------
+{
+  const { page, context } = await fresh(1440, 900, 'dark')
+  const colors = await page.evaluate(() => {

+  await context.close()
+}
+
+await browser.close()
+console.log(failures === 0 ? '\nALL FLOWS PASSED' : `\n${failures} FAILURES`)
+process.exit(failures === 0 ? 0 : 1)

# Claude Sonnet 5.5 — timezone overlap checker

Find the hours when a distributed team is awake at the same time, or compare your own schedule against colleagues in other timezones.

React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4. No runtime dependencies beyond React, `lucide-react` icons and the Inter font.

## Run it

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm dev          # http://localhost:9364
```

Other scripts: `pnpm build`, `pnpm preview` (also on 9364), `pnpm test`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`.

## How it works

- **Meeting mode** highlights the hours when *every* city is awake; all rows share the same window.
- **Base mode** compares the reference city (first row) with each other city independently.
- The grid has 24 columns, one per hour of the reference city's day. Each cell shows the local time in that city. Sleeping cells are hatched and faded, awake cells are sand, overlap cells are green.
- Click a city name to make it the reference. Removing the reference promotes the next city.
- Wake / sleep hours and 12h / 24h format live in **Settings**. Overnight windows (wake 22, sleep 6) work. Wake equal to sleep means awake all day.
- Everything is persisted to `localStorage` under `timezone-overlap:v1`; invalid stored data falls back to defaults field by field.
- Offsets come from `Intl.DateTimeFormat` at the current date, so DST and fractional offsets (India, Nepal) are correct. A column is judged awake by the local time at which it starts.
- Below 768px the grid is a separate layout: cities as columns, hours as rows, with pinned headers and a pinned reference column.

## Structure

```
src/
  data/cities.ts        catalog of 34 cities + search
  lib/timezone.ts       UTC offset from Intl
  lib/overlap.ts        pure awake / overlap / range maths (buildGrid)
  lib/format.ts         hour, range and offset formatting
  state/                reducer, validation, localStorage
  hooks/                useGrid, useNow, useMediaQuery
  components/           toolbar, picker, settings, summary, grid (desktop + mobile)
```

content.text:
The app is built and running with `pnpm install && pnpm dev` on `http://localhost:9364`. It's React 19, TypeScript, Vite and Tailwind v4.

I ran typecheck, lint, the production build and 79 tests (unit tests plus tests that click through the app), all passing. I also drove the dev server and the production preview in real Chrome at 1440, 1024, 768, 390 and 320px, in light and dark mode, and those checks passed. I stopped both servers afterwards, so port 9364 is free.

- **Title and heading:** both are exactly `Claude Sonnet 5.5`. A tagline sits under the heading as a separate line.
- **Default view:** San Francisco, Denpasar and Geneva in meeting mode, 7am–11pm awake, 12h format. Common hours are 2 (`7am — 8am` and `10pm — 11pm`), with the hint "Green cells = everyone awake" at the bottom.
- **Grid:** desktop columns line up exactly with the header (checked by pixel measurement), and the 768px case still fits. Desktop and mobile are separate layouts (city rows below 768px are city columns instead), and mobile has pinned city headers.
- **Cities and offsets:** 34 cities. Offsets follow DST and fractional zones; Mumbai and Kathmandu show `UTC+5:30` and `UTC+5:45`, with the minutes shown in the cell. The search dropdown works by keyboard, and cities already added show as disabled instead of disappearing.
- **Persistence:** cities, settings and mode are restored after a reload, and a fresh session starts on the defaults.

**Choices where your spec was open (all easy to change)**
- A column counts as awake by the local time at which it starts.
- In Base mode the reference row has no green cells, since the overlap is computed only for the other cities.
- In Base mode the hint reads "Green cells = awake at the same time as {reference}".
- Overlap ranges match the linear grid, so a window across midnight shows as two ranges.
- With fewer than two cities, no summary or green cells show, and a short hint asks you to add another city.
- Wake equal to sleep means awake all day.

I pinned TypeScript to 6.0.3 because `typescript-eslint` doesn't support 7.x yet. I also added a few things you didn't ask for: a "now" marker on the current hour, a local-midnight marker on each row, a "Reset to defaults" button in settings, dark mode, and a `README.md`.That background run reported success, but its exit code hid a problem: it showed 3 of 79 tests failing. The machine was under heavy load (load average above 60), and the slow click-through tests hit the default 5-second timeout.

I fixed it by raising the test timeout to 30 seconds and switching the simulated typing and clicking to skip its per-action delay. Rerunning after that, all 79 tests passed. Typecheck and lint were clean, and the `pnpm dev` smoke test served `Claude Sonnet 5.5` on port 9364.

Port 9364 is free, and nothing else needs doing.
